text: The room was really nice and comfortable and good value for money! Location is also nice with free private parking underground for the rooms. No lift could be used to go in the room and with a push chair and luggages it was difficult. Also, no soap in the room to shower. Would have loved to have breakfast, but i knew this was not available.

Great budget hotel for your money! Great location and friendly staff! The breakfast was very nice. Large buffet with choices. The staff was very kind and the location was perfect!!! Walking distance to the train station and everything! The temperature. Unfortunately, we could not control the temperature in the room. It is centrally controlled. I called down to the front desk to request they turn it off. They had the heat on and we were too hot! We had to open a window.
Great time great location. Like staying in amusement museum Stairs were a bit tricky

It would be a great hotel, but some of the staff are a disaster. The hotel's facilities and cleanliness were perfectly fine. The staff is a disaster! I was twice, and both times I was lucky with a lady at the reception desk, who is a horrible spider rock. He can speak unintelligible English and is very unpleasant. Room service is also a disaster! There were regularly no towels in the room! After a long day, we get back to the room and there was not a single towel in the room! After several complaints, after waiting for an hour, we only received a towel! For the one hour I wasted, the spider rock woman mentioned above did not even offer compensation, e.g. a cake or anything. In both cases, the hand wash and shower gel were out of stock! Even though I put out the empty bottles, we only got them after complaining. On our second arrival, there was a nice lady at the reception who welcomed us.
Spacious, sink, comfortable beds & heating Smell was awful, need to ventilate!

Would stay again. The hotel is very new and modern with excellent co-working facilities (I didn't know it had any until we got there). Beautifully decorated and the staff were incredibly helpful and friendly. One of the best things about staying here was that you could also go to Selina Tulum on the beach / hotel area (triple the price when we booked) and use the sun loungers, pool area, and co-working space for free.The rooftop area is a nice space to have a drink at, swim, or watch the sunrise. They also operate Good Bikes bike rental from the reception which was convenient. Only a few minutes walk to restaurants and shops. Our shower head was not functioning very well, maybe only 10 of the 50+ holes were working and the water sprayed all over the bathroom even though there is a small glass pane. Electricity seemed to go on and off irregularly throughout the day making wifi unavailable (inconvenient when applying for jobs!).

Heated floor in bathroom. Shelves in bed headboard. Blackout Curtains. Had issue where code didn't unlock front door or garbage door after day 1. Kitchen cabinets a little too crowded, so no place to store dry grocery goods.
Could not have been better. Wonderful attention to detail and fabulous location. The hosts could not have done more. Thank you. Nothing at all.

I liked the location and the facilities of the appartment. Will definetely recommend for a stay. Parking also available outside the appartment. Hot water. was very tricky. I had to wait for over an hout to get decent hot water. And while my friends were comfortable to have a shower with cold water by the time i went to have my shower there were not hot water still. never got a shower after i climbed Slieve Donard and was exhausted. But that was the only downside everything else was great and had amazing time.
